entries.title: I Kings 16:1
segments: ¶Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani, against Baasha, saying:

entries.title: I Kings 16:2
segments: "Inasmuch as I lifted you out of the dust and made you ruler over My people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam, and have made My people Israel sin, to provoke Me to anger with their sins,

entries.title: I Kings 16:3
segments: "surely I will take away the posterity of Baasha and the posterity of his house, and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

entries.title: I Kings 16:4
segments: "The dogs shall eat whoever belongs to Baasha and dies in the city, and the birds of the air shall eat whoever dies in the fields."

entries.title: I Kings 16:5
segments: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, what he did, and his might, [are] they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

entries.title: I Kings 16:6
segments: So Baasha rested with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah. Then Elah his son reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Kings 16:7
segments: And also the word of the LORD came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and his house, because of all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD in provoking Him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he killed them.

entries.title: I Kings 16:8
segments: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha became king over Israel, [and reigned] two years in Tirzah.

entries.title: I Kings 16:9
segments: Now his servant Zimri, commander of half [his] chariots, conspired against him as he was in Tirzah drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, steward of [his] house in Tirzah.

entries.title: I Kings 16:10
segments: And Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Kings 16:11
segments: Then it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he was seated on his throne, [that] he killed all the household of Baasha; he did not leave him one male, neither of his relatives nor of his friends.

entries.title: I Kings 16:12
segments: Thus Zimri destroyed all the household of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which He spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

entries.title: I Kings 16:13
segments: for all the sins of Baasha and the sins of Elah his son, by which they had sinned and by which they had made Israel sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their idols.

entries.title: I Kings 16:14
segments: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, [are] they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

entries.title: I Kings 16:15
segments: ¶In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri had reigned in Tirzah seven days. And the people [were] encamped against Gibbethon, which [belonged] to the Philistines.

entries.title: I Kings 16:16
segments: Now the people [who were] encamped heard it said, "Zimri has conspired and also has killed the king." So all Israel made Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.

entries.title: I Kings 16:17
segments: Then Omri and all Israel with him went up from Gibbethon, and they besieged Tirzah.

entries.title: I Kings 16:18
segments: And it happened, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the citadel of the king's house and burned the king's house down upon himself with fire, and died,

entries.title: I Kings 16:19
segments: because of the sins which he had committed in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he had committed to make Israel sin.

entries.title: I Kings 16:20
segments: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and the treason he committed, [are] they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

entries.title: I Kings 16:21
segments: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.

entries.title: I Kings 16:22
segments: But the people who followed Omri prevailed over the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath. So Tibni died and Omri reigned.

entries.title: I Kings 16:23
segments: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri became king over Israel, [and reigned] twelve years. Six years he reigned in Tirzah.

entries.title: I Kings 16:24
segments: And he bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver; then he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill.

entries.title: I Kings 16:25
segments: Omri did evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all who [were] before him.

entries.title: I Kings 16:26
segments: For he walked in all the ways of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin by which he had made Israel sin, provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their idols.

entries.title: I Kings 16:27
segments: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and the might that he showed, [are] they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

entries.title: I Kings 16:28
segments: So Omri rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria. Then Ahab his son reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Kings 16:29
segments: ¶In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri became king over Israel; and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

entries.title: I Kings 16:30
segments: Now Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD, more than all who [were] before him.

entries.title: I Kings 16:31
segments: And it came to pass, as though it had been a trivial thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal, king of the Sidonians; and he went and served Baal and worshiped him.

entries.title: I Kings 16:32
segments: Then he set up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

entries.title: I Kings 16:33
segments: And Ahab made a wooden image. Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.

entries.title: I Kings 16:34
segments: In his days Hiel of Bethel built Jericho. He laid its foundation with Abiram his firstborn, and with his youngest [son] Segub he set up its gates, according to the word of the LORD, which He had spoken through Joshua the son of Nun.
